import { parseFen } from './fen.mjs'
import { legalMovesOf, makeMove } from './movegen.mjs'

function count(pos, depth) {
  if (depth === 0) return 1
  const moves = legalMovesOf(pos)
  if (depth === 1) return moves.length
  let total = 0
  for (const move of moves) total += count(makeMove(pos, move), depth - 1)
  return total
}

export function perft(fen, depth) {
  return count(parseFen(fen), depth)
}
